import math, json

INK, MUT, FAINT, ACC, OCH = "#111111", "#6b6a60", "#9b998c", "#8c2f1f", "#8a6a1e"
FONT = "Palatino,Georgia,serif"

def txt(x, y, s, size=10, color=MUT, w=400, anchor="middle", style="", tid=None):
    tid_attr = f"id='{tid}' " if tid else ""
    return (f"<text {tid_attr}x='{x:.1f}' y='{y:.1f}' font-family='{FONT}' font-size='{size}' "
            f"fill='{color}' font-weight='{w}' text-anchor='{anchor}' {style}>{s}</text>")

def cap(xc, y, name, sub=None, color=MUT, name_color=None):
    out = [txt(xc, y, name, 10.5, name_color or (INK if color == MUT else color), 600)]
    if sub:
        out.append(txt(xc, y + 12, sub, 9.5, color))
    return "".join(out)

def harrow(x1, x2, y, label=None, color=FAINT):
    out = [f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{y}' x2='{x2 - 5}' y2='{y}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
           f"<path d='M {x2},{y} l -6,-3 v 6 Z' fill='{color}'/>"]
    if label:
        out.append(txt((x1 + x2) / 2, y - 6, label, 9, FAINT, style="font-style='italic'"))
    return "".join(out)

def diag_arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label=None, labx=None, laby=None):
    ang = math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1)
    bx, by = x2 - 7*math.cos(ang), y2 - 7*math.sin(ang)
    out = [f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{y1}' x2='{bx:.1f}' y2='{by:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>"]
    perp = ang + math.pi/2
    p1 = (x2 - 7*math.cos(ang) + 3*math.cos(perp), y2 - 7*math.sin(ang) + 3*math.sin(perp))
    p2 = (x2 - 7*math.cos(ang) - 3*math.cos(perp), y2 - 7*math.sin(ang) - 3*math.sin(perp))
    out.append(f"<path d='M {x2},{y2} L {p1[0]:.1f},{p1[1]:.1f} L {p2[0]:.1f},{p2[1]:.1f} Z' fill='{color}'/>")
    if label:
        out.append(txt(labx, laby, label, 8.5, FAINT, style="font-style='italic'"))
    return "".join(out)

def leader(x1, y1, x2, y2, color):
    return (f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{y1}' x2='{x2}' y2='{y2}' stroke='{color}' "
            f"stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 4'/>")

def slab(x, yc, s, d, color=INK):
    y = yc - s / 2
    dx, dy = d, d * 0.55
    out = [
        f"<polygon points='{x},{y} {x+dx},{y-dy} {x+dx+s},{y-dy} {x+s},{y}' "
        f"fill='#00000010' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
        f"<polygon points='{x+s},{y} {x+dx+s},{y-dy} {x+dx+s},{y-dy+s} {x+s},{y+s}' "
        f"fill='#0000001c' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
        f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='{s}' height='{s}' fill='#00000006' "
        f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.1'/>",
    ]
    return "".join(out), s + dx

def bar(x, yc, h, color=INK, ticks=9):
    y = yc - h / 2
    out = [f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='6' height='{h}' fill='none' "
           f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.1'/>"]
    for i in range(1, ticks):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y + i * h / ticks:.1f}' x2='{x + 6}' "
                   f"y2='{y + i * h / ticks:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.45' opacity='0.5'/>")
    return "".join(out), 6

def fan(x1, yc1, h1, x2, yc2, h2, color=FAINT, n=5):
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        ya = yc1 - h1 / 2 + (i + 0.5) * h1 / n
        for j in range(n):
            yb = yc2 - h2 / 2 + (j + 0.5) * h2 / n
            out.append(f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{ya:.1f}' x2='{x2}' y2='{yb:.1f}' "
                       f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.45' opacity='0.4'/>")
    return "".join(out)

def gridsq(x, yc, s, n, color=INK, bumps=(), lw=1.1):
    y = yc - s / 2
    out = [f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='{s}' height='{s}' fill='none' "
           f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='{lw}'/>"]
    for i in range(1, n):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x + i * s / n:.1f}' y1='{y}' x2='{x + i * s / n:.1f}' "
                   f"y2='{y + s}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.4' opacity='0.5'/>")
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y + i * s / n:.1f}' x2='{x + s}' "
                   f"y2='{y + i * s / n:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.4' opacity='0.5'/>")
    for (gx, gy, o) in bumps:
        out.append(f"<rect x='{x + gx * s / n:.1f}' y='{y + gy * s / n:.1f}' "
                   f"width='{s / n:.1f}' height='{s / n:.1f}' fill='{color}' fill-opacity='{o}'/>")
    return "".join(out), s, (x, y)

def crosspt(x, y, color, r=7):
    return (f"<line x1='{x - r}' y1='{y}' x2='{x + r}' y2='{y}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.3'/>"
            f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y - r}' x2='{x}' y2='{y + r}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.3'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{y}' r='{r * 0.55:.1f}' fill='none' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.3'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{y}' r='1.4' fill='{color}'/>")

def converge(src_pts, tx, ty, color):
    out = []
    for (sx, sy) in src_pts:
        out.append(f"<line x1='{sx:.1f}' y1='{sy:.1f}' x2='{tx}' y2='{ty}' "
                   f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.4'/>")
    out.append(crosspt(tx, ty, color))
    return "".join(out)

def gauge(x, yc, color=MUT, r=13):
    a = math.radians(55)
    return (f"<path d='M {x - r},{yc} A {r} {r} 0 0 1 {x + r},{yc}' fill='none' "
            f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.2'/>"
            f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{yc}' x2='{x + (r - 3) * math.cos(a):.1f}' "
            f"y2='{yc - (r - 3) * math.sin(a):.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.3'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{yc}' r='1.5' fill='{color}'/>")

def kernel_proj(x1, s1, x2, s2, yc, color):
    k = max(5, s1 * 0.30)
    kx, ky = x1 + s1 * 0.60, yc - s1 / 2 + s1 * 0.18
    c = max(3, s2 * 0.14)
    cx, cy = x2 + s2 * 0.22, yc - s2 / 2 + s2 * 0.26
    out = [f"<rect x='{kx:.1f}' y='{ky:.1f}' width='{k:.1f}' height='{k:.1f}' "
           f"fill='none' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.85'/>",
           f"<rect x='{cx:.1f}' y='{cy:.1f}' width='{c:.1f}' height='{c:.1f}' "
           f"fill='{color}' fill-opacity='0.5' stroke='none'/>"]
    for (px, py) in ((kx, ky), (kx + k, ky), (kx, ky + k), (kx + k, ky + k)):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{px:.1f}' y1='{py:.1f}' x2='{cx + c / 2:.1f}' "
                   f"y2='{cy + c / 2:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.5' "
                   f"opacity='0.45'/>")
    return "".join(out)

IC = 170  # main inference lane (frame / merged field / decode / output)
YA, YB = 82, 258  # member A / member B lane centers
LOSS_Y = 452
H = 500

body = []
body.append(txt(8, 26, "INFERENCE PATH — WHAT FLIES", 9, FAINT, 600, "start", "letter-spacing='1.8'"))
body.append(txt(8, LOSS_Y - 34, "TRAINING SIGNALS — NEVER FLY", 9, OCH, 600, "start", "letter-spacing='1.8'"))

# --- camera frame (frozen, verbatim glyph) ---
Y = IC - 38
def terrain_frame(y):
    return (
        f"<g id='cam-terrain'>"
        f"<rect id='frozen-input' x='26' y='{y}' width='76' height='76' "
        f"fill='#f6f4ea' stroke='#9b998c' stroke-width='1.6'/>"
        f"<path d='M31 {y + 47} L97 {y + 27}' stroke='#e6e3d4' stroke-width='5' fill='none'/>"
        f"<path d='M59 {y + 6} L49 {y + 70}' stroke='#e6e3d4' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none'/>"
        f"<rect x='34' y='{y + 9}' width='12' height='8' fill='#d9d5c3' transform='rotate(-8 40 {y + 13})'/>"
        f"<rect x='78' y='{y + 8}' width='10' height='11' fill='#cfccbd'/>"
        f"<rect x='35' y='{y + 57}' width='13' height='8' fill='#d9d5c3'/>"
        f"<rect x='75' y='{y + 50}' width='10' height='9' fill='#cfccbd' transform='rotate(6 80 {y + 54})'/>"
        f"<rect x='54' y='{y + 31}' width='9' height='8' fill='#d9d5c3' opacity='.85'/>"
        f"<ellipse cx='86' cy='{y + 63}' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8a6a1e' opacity='.12'/>"
        f"<circle cx='40' cy='{y + 28}' r='.7' fill='#6b6a60' opacity='.5'/>"
        f"<circle cx='70' cy='{y + 14}' r='.7' fill='#6b6a60' opacity='.5'/>"
        f"<circle cx='92' cy='{y + 36}' r='.7' fill='#6b6a60' opacity='.5'/>"
        f"<circle cx='52' cy='{y + 52}' r='.7' fill='#6b6a60' opacity='.5'/>"
        f"<circle cx='82' cy='{y + 70}' r='.7' fill='#6b6a60' opacity='.5'/>"
        f"<circle cx='31' cy='{y + 42}' r='.7' fill='#6b6a60' opacity='.5'/>"
        f"</g>")
body.append(terrain_frame(Y))
body.append(txt(53, IC - 44, "128²×3", 9, FAINT))
body.append(txt(53, IC + 48, "camera frame", 10.5, MUT, 600))
body.append(txt(53, IC + 60, "one Berlin TrueDOP survey crop", 9.5, FAINT))
body.append(txt(53, IC + 73, "frozen contract", 8.5, FAINT, style="font-style='italic'"))

# --- split into two independent members ---
body.append(diag_arrow(108, IC, 130, YA, FAINT))
body.append(diag_arrow(108, IC, 130, YB, FAINT))
body.append(txt(94, IC - 86, "no shared weights", 8.5, FAINT, anchor="start", style="font-style='italic'"))

def member(yc, color, bumps, letter):
    x = 130
    sizes = [(26, 5), (19, 7), (14, 9), (10, 11)]
    faces = []
    out = []
    for i, (s, d) in enumerate(sizes):
        g, w = slab(x, yc, s, d, color)
        out.append(g)
        faces.append((x, s))
        x += w + 8
    x -= 8
    for (x1, s1), (x2, s2) in zip(faces, faces[1:]):
        out.append(kernel_proj(x1, s1, x2, s2, yc, color))
    out.append(cap((130 + x) / 2, yc + 34, f"member {letter} trunk", "conv 3×3 ×4, 112ch top",
                    name_color=color))
    out.append(txt(136, yc - 20, "128²×3", 9, FAINT))
    out.append(txt(x - 14, yc - 18, "8²×112", 9, FAINT))
    trunk_end = x
    out.append(harrow(trunk_end + 4, trunk_end + 16, yc))
    x = trunk_end + 18
    g, w = bar(x, yc, 30, color, ticks=8)
    out.append(g)
    out.append(cap(x + 3, yc - 26, "112-d", "GAP", color=FAINT))
    bar_x = x
    x2 = x + 40
    g2, w2 = bar(x2, yc, 14, color, ticks=3)
    out.append(fan(x + 6, yc, 30, x2, yc, 14, color))
    out.append(g2)
    out.append(cap(x2 + 3, yc + 32, "FC → 2970", "logits", color=FAINT))
    x = x2 + 24
    out.append(harrow(x, x + 14, yc))
    gx = x + 16
    g3, gs, (fx0, fy0) = gridsq(gx, yc, 58, 8, color, bumps)
    out.append(g3)
    out.append(cap(gx + gs / 2, yc - 34, f"belief field {letter}", "2970 map cells", color=FAINT))
    field_right = gx + gs
    return "".join(out), field_right, bar_x

BUMP_A = ((5, 2, .55), (4, 2, .25), (5, 1, .25), (5, 3, .18), (2, 5, .12))
BUMP_B = ((5, 2, .5), (4, 2, .22), (5, 1, .3), (6, 3, .2), (1, 1, .15))

gA, fieldRightA, barXA = member(YA, ACC, BUMP_A, "A")
gB, fieldRightB, barXB = member(YB, ACC, BUMP_B, "B")
body.append(gA)
body.append(gB)
field_right = max(fieldRightA, fieldRightB)

# --- merge: average the two members' belief fields ---
MFX, MFS = field_right + 56, 58
mg, mgs, (mfx0, mfy0) = gridsq(MFX, IC, MFS, 8, INK, ((5, 2, .5), (4, 2, .22), (5, 1, .22), (5, 3, .14)))
body.append(diag_arrow(field_right, YA, MFX - 2, IC - 8, ACC))
body.append(diag_arrow(field_right, YB, MFX - 2, IC + 8, ACC))
body.append(txt((field_right + MFX) / 2 - 6, IC - 26, "average", 9, ACC, 600, style="font-style='italic'"))
body.append(mg)
body.append(cap(MFX + MFS / 2, IC - 58, "averaged belief  p̄", "mean of both members' 2970-cell softmax",
                name_color=ACC))

# highlighted 3x3 consensus block on the merged field (local belief pooling, unchanged)
blk_gx, blk_gy = 4, 1  # top-left grid cell of the 3x3 block (matches the (5,2) bump)
bx = mfx0 + blk_gx * mgs / 8
by = mfy0 + blk_gy * mgs / 8
bs = 3 * mgs / 8
body.append(f"<rect x='{bx:.1f}' y='{by:.1f}' width='{bs:.1f}' height='{bs:.1f}' "
            f"fill='none' stroke='{INK}' stroke-width='1.8'/>")

# decode: pooled centroid + offset -> crosspt (unchanged mechanism)
tx, ty = 812, IC
src = []
for gyy in range(blk_gy, blk_gy + 3):
    for gxx in range(blk_gx, blk_gx + 3):
        src.append((mfx0 + (gxx + 0.5) * mgs / 8, mfy0 + (gyy + 0.5) * mgs / 8))
body.append(converge(src, tx, ty, INK))
body.append(cap((MFX + mgs + tx) / 2 + 6, IC - 90, "pooled centroid of the 3×3 block",
                "+ mean of both members' offset nudges", color=MUT))

# --- confidence gate: min of each member's own mass on THIS block ---
block_cx, block_cy = bx + bs / 2, by + bs / 2
gate_x, gate_y = MFX + MFS / 2, IC + 110
body.append(leader(block_cx, by, block_cx - 10, gate_y - 14, ACC))
body.append(txt(block_cx - 14, gate_y - 20, "member A mass on this block", 8.2, ACC,
                anchor="end", style="font-style='italic'"))
body.append(leader(block_cx, by + bs, block_cx + 10, gate_y - 14, ACC))
body.append(txt(block_cx + 14, gate_y - 6, "member B mass on this block", 8.2, ACC,
                anchor="start", style="font-style='italic'"))
body.append(gauge(gate_x, gate_y, ACC))
body.append(txt(gate_x, gate_y + 20, "confidence = min(mA, mB)", 9.5, ACC, 600))
body.append(txt(gate_x, gate_y + 32, "both members must back the winning block", 8.5, ACC))

ex = tx + 46
body.append(f"<path d='M {gate_x},{gate_y + 40} V {gate_y + 60} H {ex} V {IC + 26}' fill='none' "
            f"stroke='{ACC}' stroke-width='0.8'/>")
body.append(f"<path d='M {ex},{IC + 20} l -3,6 h 6 Z' fill='{ACC}'/>")
body.append(txt((gate_x + ex) / 2, gate_y + 54, "may abstain instead of guessing", 8.5, ACC,
                style="font-style='italic'"))

body.append(crosspt(tx, ty, INK))
body.append(txt(828, IC - 18, "frozen contract", 8.5, FAINT, anchor="start", style="font-style='italic'"))
body.append(txt(828, IC - 2, "(lat, lon, confidence)", 13, MUT, 600, "start", tid="frozen-output"))
body.append(txt(828, IC + 12, "position fix + confidence", 9, FAINT, anchor="start"))

# --- training lane (train-only, changed -> red) ---
body.append(leader(190, YA + 20, 190, LOSS_Y - 70, ACC))
body.append(leader(190, YB - 20, 190, LOSS_Y - 70, ACC))
tglyph, tgs, _ = gridsq(176, LOSS_Y - 54, 20, 6, ACC, ((3, 2, .6),))
body.append(tglyph)
body.append(txt(206, LOSS_Y - 60, "each member: own augmented crop (brightness/contrast/blur/grain)", 10, ACC, 600, "start"))
body.append(txt(206, LOSS_Y - 48, "+ own soft-CE cell loss + own offset loss, from its own argmax", 9.5, ACC, 400, "start"))
body.append(txt(206, LOSS_Y - 36, "no agreement term — diversity is the mechanism; two losses summed, one optimizer step",
                9.5, ACC, 400, "start"))
body.append(txt(968, LOSS_Y - 36, "paired three-survey batches, targets, schedule unchanged", 9, FAINT,
                anchor="end", style="font-style='italic'"))

svg = f"<svg viewBox='0 0 980 {H}' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img'>{''.join(body)}</svg>"
out = {"architecture_svg": svg}
with open("runs/20261101_110104_experiment7/figure.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(out, f)
print("bytes:", len(svg))
